messages:
Nadia: planning a coordinated base-image refresh this month. goal: shrink attack surface, enable stricter admission checks, and integrate KMS-backed signing into the CI flow.
Lee: +1. which registries and clusters are on the list? staging, canary, prod?
Nadia: staging + internal canary cluster first. prod needs an opt-in window after we validate signing + admission.
Sam: KMS question  do we want per-cluster KMS keys or per-environment keys? per-cluster is more isolation but more ops overhead.
Priya: recommend per-environment (staging/canary/prod). keep one key per environment and rotate on schedule.
Nadia: okay per-env keys. pipeline SAs should have the minimal IAM binding: SignOnly. no decrypt, no kms:decrypt.
Lee: I'll sketch an RBAC/secret access pattern. prefer binding to a dedicated namespace secret and use resourceNames to limit which secret can be read. example Role:

```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  namespace: image-signing
  name: pipeline-signer
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  resourceNames: ["cosign-staging-key"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```

and RoleBinding to the CI runner SA.
Sam: good, that avoids cluster-wide secret access. we should also annotate the secret with `signer=cosign` and enforce via admission.
Priya: on audit retention: security asked for 270d for signing events and 730d for image push events. legal okayed 730d for push metadata.
Nadia: capture these fields in logs: env, signer_kms_key, cosign_key_id, job_id, artifact_digest, cosine_signature (no PII).
Lee: logging/ops: @ops-bot can you create an index `img-sign-audit` and an ingestion pipeline to normalize signer_kms_key and job_id fields?
ops-bot: TASK_CREATED img-sign-audit-index (owner: Sam). ETA 2d.
Sam: I'll put the schema in the logging repo and request write creds via vault role.
Nadia: vuln triage: are there any blockers? I saw libarchive CVE-2024-7001 in the build deps. severity: medium.
Priya: blocking issue: openssl CVE-2025-4455 marked high on our policy. must patch before any prod rollout.
Sam: we can rebuild with the patched openssl and run a post-build scan. proposed gate: fail the roll if trivy reports any CRITICAL or HIGH. use this command in CI:

```
trivy image --severity CRITICAL,HIGH -q --format json $IMAGE > scan.json
if jq '.Results[].Vulnerabilities | map(select(.Severity=="CRITICAL" or .Severity=="HIGH")) | length' scan.json | grep -q '^0$'; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi
```

Nadia: nice. also add an allowlist for a small set of approved non-fixable low/medium vulns with rationale.
Lee: incident/compromise playbook suggestions: if a signed digest is compromised -> immediate key revocation, add digest to registry blacklist, rotate runners, and produce hotfix images. sequence: 1) revoke key, 2) mark digest blacklisted, 3) deploy hotfix and update admission fallback, 4) notify incident channel + full audit export.
Sam: who implements the blacklist enforcement? infra or platform?
Priya: infra implements registry metadata changes. platform will add the admission plugin to reject blacklisted digests.
Lee: I'll open an RFC for a lightweight blacklist API: POST /v1/blacklist {digest, reason, incident_id}. controller will generate an event and annotate images.
ops-bot: RFC_CREATED blacklist-api (owner: Lee).
Nadia: fallback policy: admission should accept a `rollback-to` label on deployment if verification fails, and the rollout system should prefer the last-verified digest.
Sam: also add a metric/alert: signer_sa_unexpected_usage when a signer SA is used outside expected runner IP ranges or pipeline IDs. alert to secops.
Priya: good call. and add an audit rule to export KMS key usage logs to our secure bucket daily. retention for those logs should match signing events (270d).
Lee: timeline and owners: Sam: logging index + vault creds (ETA 48h). Priya: CI gating + trivy policy (ETA 2d). Lee: RBAC + admission webhook to enforce secret annotation (ETA 3d). Nadia: coordination doc + rollout plan + legal checklist (ETA 1d).
Nadia: any other blockers? if not, I'll create the coordination doc and invite owners. :thumbsup:
Sam: one tiny note  make sure cosign verification in admission supports both KMS URIs and legacy local keys for transition.
Priya: will include that in the policy.
Nadia: thanks all. I'll post the doc link in this channel once ready.
